title: Otter eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#A0714F'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='30' r='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#D4B48C'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='39' r='3' fill='#2C1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='3' fill='#2C1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3D2314'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M47 49 Q50 52 53 49' stroke='#5A3A22' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='45' x2='38' y2='46' stroke='#E8D5B8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='48' x2='38' y2='49' stroke='#E8D5B8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='45' x2='62' y2='46' stroke='#E8D5B8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='48' x2='62' y2='49' stroke='#E8D5B8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='62' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-20 35 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='62' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(20 65 62)'/>
  <!-- snack: fish -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#5BA8D4'/>
  <polygon points='60,60 68,54 68,66' fill='#4A90B8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='59' r='1.2' fill='#1A3A4A'/>
  <!-- fish shine -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58.5' rx='6' ry='1.5' fill='#8ED0F0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#7A5130'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#7A5130'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#7A5130'/>
</svg>
